environment_notes: No local Poppler renderer is installed. The PDF artifact-operation marker succeeded, and temporary application-native branded-certificate QA output was rendered at 2x with installed PyMuPDF, visually inspected, and removed; witnessed authorization/download/print review remains a human UAT gate.
Firefox required execution outside the restricted process sandbox on this Windows host so its tab subprocess could start; it then passed all ten configured tests in the complete 40/40 suite.

Playwright's Windows-hosted WebKit follows Safari's default setting that omits links from Tab order unless full keyboard access is enabled. Automation verified visible skip-link focus and keyboard activation with focus supplied as test setup; a real Safari/full-keyboard-access witness remains part of human UAT.

The controlled human evidence template is docs/UAT_EXECUTION_RECORD.md; its remaining blank human-result fields intentionally do not claim that UAT, PDF visual review, email delivery, backup restoration, production configuration, or deployment approval passed.

Laravel db:show --counts cannot read performance_schema.session_status in this XAMPP MariaDB installation; migrate:status and direct application-table queries succeed, so this affects the optional diagnostic command rather than application operation.

The local UAT archive is on-site, unencrypted, and synthetic; it does not satisfy the pending production requirements for encrypted off-site/versioned storage, monitoring, approved RPO/RTO, or a production-format restore drill.

The PDF artifact marker and Poppler are unavailable. Temporary application-native QA PDFs were rendered with installed PyMuPDF and removed after inspection; human authorization/download/print review remains a UAT gate.
